title: test(app-shell): re-point the ObjectSchema corpus guards to 48 after sharing was adopted
body:
Fixes #26218
Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## What

Re-points the `ObjectSchema` key-count corpus guard from 47 to 48 in the two app-shell tests that pin it:

- `ui/packages/app-shell/src/services/MetadataService.retiredObjectEnabled.test.ts` (was :161)
- `ui/packages/app-shell/src/services/MetadataService.specKeyObjectPayload.test.ts` (was :175)

Each file gains one entry in its existing re-point comment block, in the same style as the five earlier re-points. The membership assertions under the count are unchanged. The diff touches tests only: no product source, no spec, no workflow, and no `scripts/sdui-manifest.*` (app-shell is outside the sdui registry closure).

## Why

5e113b39 (#26005) added the top-level `sharing` key to `ObjectSchema`. Both guards then read `expected 48 to be 47`, and Test UI went red on every PR's merge ref (#26213: shard 8/16, check-run 121679452481, and shard 2/16, check-run 121679452468).

## Measurement

`Object.keys(ObjectSchema.shape)` was read from `packages/spec/src/data/object.zod.ts` at each commit. The source was extracted with `git archive` and imported with tsx.

| commit | count | delta vs previous |
|---|---|---|
| fbb75998 (5e113b39^) | 47 | none (control) |
| 5e113b39 (#26005) | 48 | gained exactly `['sharing']`, lost set empty |
| 43b47156 (origin/main at branch point) | 48 | gained none, lost none |

No later `main` commit moved the count again. `git grep` on origin/main for `toBe(47)` together with `ObjectSchema.shape` under `ui/` finds only these two guards.

## Red, then green

Both files were run as one command: `bash scripts/pm/os-verify-lock.sh -c 'cd ui && pnpm exec vitest run --maxWorkers=2 FILE_A FILE_B'`. The spec and `@objectstack/client` dependency closure were built first.

- **Red** at 43b47156 (unchanged base): `AssertionError: expected 48 to be 47` at `retiredObjectEnabled.test.ts:161:25` and at `specKeyObjectPayload.test.ts:175:25`. Result: Test Files 2 failed (2), Tests 2 failed | 23 passed (25), and the lock printed `VERDICT command-exit 1`.
- **Green** at 56d05d60: Test Files 2 passed (2), Tests 25 passed (25), and the lock printed `VERDICT command-exit 0`.

## Changeset

None. The diff is test-only and publishes nothing: app-shell's `files[]` is `dist`, `src/styles.css`, `README.md`, `CHANGELOG.md` and `LICENSE`. The PR carries `skip-changeset`, the same as #26212.

## Gates (local, at 56d05d60)

`node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack` derived 24 commands from the 2-path change set. All 24 were run, and each exited 0. The reconciliation `--ran` reported: `24 derived, 24 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED, 0 UNRUN`, with every line exit-coded. Every other family, along with Type Check UI and the full Test UI shards, is declared to CI. Their verdicts are the PR check-runs.

## Acceptance notes

- Gap: #26005 changed `packages/spec`, but its CI never ran this ui suite. That turbo/CI filter gap is #26092's work. #26092 is not addressed here.
